descriptionAdvanced.en: Iquique is a striking coastal city in the Atacama Desert, famous for its history during the saltpeter boom and its modern duty-free shopping zone. The city's Baquedano Street features beautifully preserved wooden mansions that showcase the wealth generated by the nitrate industry in the 19th century. Today, Iquique is a top destination for adventure seekers, offering some of the world's best conditions for paragliding and surfing at Cavancha Beach. The massive Dragon Hill sand dune towers over the city, providing a dramatic backdrop and a playground for sandboarders. It is a city where history meets high-octane sports and international trade.

en: The Zofri (Free Trade Zone) is one of the largest and most important commercial hubs in South America.
Home to a full-scale replica of the Esmeralda, a warship famous for the Battle of Iquique.
Cerro Dragón is one of the highest urban sand dunes in the world, stretching over 4 kilometers.
Located near the Humberstone and Santa Laura Saltpeter Works, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Cavancha Beach is renowned for its warm waters and year-round surfable waves.
